profile.description:
Pro Link Systems has delivered managed IT services to Los Angeles businesses since 1999. From Woodland Hills to Downtown LA, we serve as the complete IT department for companies with 5 or more employees — providing 24/7 live help desk support, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, disaster recovery, and virtual CIO strategy under one flat-rate agreement. No long-term contracts.
Unlike break-fix IT companies, we monitor and manage your environment proactively so problems don't start. Real engineers answer your calls around the clock — no ticket queues, no offshore support. We are HIPAA, PCI, CMMC, and SOC 2 compliant and serve clients across healthcare, legal, manufacturing, aerospace, hospitality, and entertainment.
Call 1-800-890-6133

structuredServiceItem.description: With IT consulting services, we help clients assess different technology strategies and align their business process with our advice. These advisory measures can be anything from strategic planning for new projects or systems implementation down to operational support.

label.description: IT support is an important part of any computer system, and Prolink offers remote assistance to solve your problems quickly. With this service you can contact our chat or email interface in order to get the problem solved within minutes!

Cloud networking is an innovative approach to managing IT infrastructure. Cloud providers offer a range of services, from hosting data center resources in their own systems or by partnering with other companies on demand--to providing security for networks that are shared across multiple locations.

label.description: With managed IT services, organizations can benefit from reduced in-house workload or gaps left by existing roles and skills. The remote Hybrid IaaS model is an excellent choice for companies who need 24/7 coverage without having to hire additional staff members on top of what they already have.

Network configuration is the process of assigning network settings, policies and flows. In a virtual environment this can be done easily because physical devices are replaced by software to make changes that require less manual labor.

Network troubleshooting is the combined measures and processes used to identify, diagnose and solve problems within a computer network. It's an imperfect science that explores every corner of your system in order find what might be going wrong - or how you can make it better!

Remote desktop support is a service that allows you to access your computer or device from anywhere with an internet connection. You can use it for things like troubleshooting software, installing new applications on the remote machine and even backing up important files.
Voice over IP (VoIP), which is the technology that allows you to make a call from your computer, VoIP phone or any other data-driven device.

Every fall, businesses build next year's technology budget. Most build it in a hurry — or copy last year's and change the date.

But a technology plan isn't a shopping list. Three moves make the difference: start with the business, not the hardware. Replace on a schedule, not in a crisis. And budget for security and reliability on purpose — as a line you chose, not a surprise you absorb.

The businesses that spend well on technology don't spend more. They spend on purpose.

Our planning framework is free. No form, no email required.

Read it before you need it. It's free — no form, no email required.
